遊戲EA版發售以來，我們收到了玩家們的大量回饋~感謝大家遊玩和支持我們的遊戲！遊戲劇情能被大部分玩家認可甚感欣慰，對於大家回饋比較多任務引導不足的問題，我們通過加班加點針對性的開發製作了“任務位置追蹤”功能，希望可以讓玩家在遊玩的時候減少因迷路導致影響遊戲體驗的問題，同時我們也開發了一個功能開關，如果有像“老大”我一樣“老學校”的老武俠遊戲迷，也可以手動關閉這個功能，享受抽絲剝繭自己尋找到答案的樂趣~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/56fe51575185aecdfd12c648ceec12186661fb11.png[/img]
地圖上可看到任務位置，滑鼠懸停後可看到相關資訊

感謝大家積極回饋BUG建議，我們在收到回饋後都會第一時間處理並更新解決。

如何回饋BUG問題及建議：加入官方QQ群1001490115，將遇到的BUG統一私聊發給QQ350867126（昵稱：老大）即可，可能會由於消息太多或者太忙沒辦法一一回復，但大家回饋的問題都會被看到，謝謝大家！

notes.title: 2025-3-18重大更新！
notes.content:
1、更新了[u][b]任务的地图标志[/b][/u]，现在在世界地图可以看到追踪任务点的具体位置，同时在世界地图的右上角有一个开关，喜欢自己探索的玩家可以关闭这个开关

6、修复了一些文本显示问题

前段时间我们给程序加上了一个[b]反盗版破解的壳[/b]，因此有些玩家的win防火墙误认为我们是病毒并且删除我们的exe文件，可能会严重影响了大家的游玩，我们思索再三，决定[b]以玩家的体验为重[/b]，去掉这个壳，请大家理解>_<

notes.title: Explanation of the Situation on the EA Launch
notes.content:
[i]Beast Saga[/i] was launched today at 2:00 AM UTC. At the moment of release, we were incredibly excited, fully aware that we would soon face significant challenges. Here, we would like to express our gratitude once again to the players, fans, and friends who have consistently supported, understood, and accompanied us, as well as those who participated in crowdfunding during our most challenging times.​

As this is an Early Access version, despite multiple tests, it has not undergone extensive deep testing. Inevitably, some undiscovered issues have surfaced post-launch due to a large influx of players and the increased content available for play, leading to a sudden outbreak of problems that have left us overwhelmed. We would like to explain some of the important issues encountered and hope for your understanding and support. Thank you very much!​

[olist]
[*] Regarding the release time displayed on the store page: Our official EA release date is March 5th. However, due to an unknown bug, the displayed release date is Dec 31st. We are currently communicating with the Steam to resolve this issue.​

[*] Regarding controller compatibility issues: After receiving feedback, we promptly released a patch and will continue to further optimize the controller operation experience.​

[*] Regarding character collision causing map glitches: We are currently working on optimizing model collisions to significantly reduce instances where collisions cause character issues. Once optimization is complete, we will update it immediately.​

[*] Regarding sudden crashes during gameplay: This issue is indeed quite complex, as the causes of crashes vary among players. We are fully investigating and addressing these issues and will gradually release updates to fix them. For compatibility crashes caused by the Windows 11 system, players can try disabling antivirus software before re-downloading and launching the game.​

[*] Regarding bugs encountered during gameplay: Upon receiving feedback, we will promptly fix them and release quick updates.​
[/olist]

How to report bugs and suggestions: Join our Discord and report bugs in the feedback channel. Thank you all!

notes.title: Beast Saga Early Access Launches Today
notes.content:
The indie game Beast Saga Early Access officially launches on Steam today! Priced at $17.99, with a limited-time 10% launch discount. Fully compatible with Steam Deck and full controller support. Step into this legendary martial world and craft your own legend!


Gameplay Trailer  Link：https://youtu.be/BXg8Tu-KhtM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/72b0eab1ea2e24fba5b7e683a6917b18e4cc1aae.png[/img]


[h3]Endless Possibilities in an Open World[/h3]
Beast Saga presents a truly open-world CRPG, featuring a webbed narrative and multiple non-linear endings at its core. Every choice shapes a different fate, and each conversation or exploration may uncover hidden secrets of the martial world. The game blends diverse gameplay elements, including gathering and crafting, life skills, martial arts and inner cultivation, forging bonds with heroes, and unexpected Jianghu encounters. Players can freely navigate between seven major sects and numerous secret factions, experiencing a legendary martial adventure that is uniquely their own.

[h3]Interwoven Fates, Diverse Endings[/h3]
From the very beginning, Beast Saga branches into numerous diverging paths. Even in the starting village, multiple story routes unfold—many players who experienced the demo have wondered whether it’s possible to save Lang Ying. The live demo will showcase how different outcomes are hidden within every choice you make. Through careful exploration and gathering information, not only can you save Lang Ying, but you may also prevent tragedy from befalling Shou and Hua. Their fates in the prologue will, in turn, influence later story developments and quest branches.

Upon reaching Xunhezhuang, the first major story arc will further emphasize exploration. Within its enclosed setting, you’ll have the freedom to investigate, while your diverse party members—each with their own distinct personalities—will shape the unfolding narrative, ensuring every player's journey through Jianghu feels unique. In the second chapter, the amount of clues you uncover and the choices you make will lead to drastically different endings—without an absolute "good" or "bad" conclusion. Follow your heart, make your own decisions, and experience a Jianghu tale that belongs solely to you.

[h3]A Martial World of Seven Sects and Hidden Factions[/h3]
The game meticulously crafts a vast martial world, home to seven major sects and numerous hidden factions. Each sect boasts a unique martial arts system and exclusive story quests, with distinct mission designs that create diverse gameplay experiences across different sects.

But Jianghu is more than just righteous sects and traditional martial clans. You can rise to become the master of a manor, trade and amass wealth, or even join secret factions specializing in theft and assassination. Through free exploration, countless secrets await discovery, and as the truth gradually comes to light, the full scope of this original martial world will unfold through your journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/714c0fc42a52d79f93e60bf0eebcabcf51b67b90.png[/img]

One of the Seven Major Sects: Bibaoshan Manor

[h3]The Power of Choice, Infinite Possibilities[/h3]
Beast Saga's webbed narrative system ensures that each quest offers at least two or more solutions. Your decisions throughout the story will directly impact NPCs' attitudes toward you, alter the course of events, and even determine the fate of your character. Some choices may draw you into Jianghu's conspiracies and conflicts, trigger hidden quests, uncover treasure-filled secret realms, or lead to unexpected encounters, all of which will further influence the progression of other quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/625e7c8d176005bd6f133cbcefeb2666fde2e8de.png[/img]

Multiple Ending Choices in Side Quests

[h3]The Many Forms of Jianghu in the Cycle of Day and Night, Sun and Rain[/h3]
The game features a time and weather system that adds depth to the experience. As night falls, locations like inns and money shops close their doors, and some NPCs disappear, while characters from the underworld may only appear in the dark of night. Certain creatures, like insects, only become active at specific times, and some story events can only be triggered during certain periods. Of course, by mastering life skills like lockpicking, you can break into closed places at night and experience a different side of Jianghu under the moonlit sky.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/b64cf2c01fa919a7801df89cd1fc40cb99a1ef7b.png[/img]

Lockpicking at Night

[h3]Freely Combine Martial Arts, Breaking the Boundaries of Sects[/h3]
With over 300 martial arts skills to master, the game breaks the traditional boundaries of sects in martial games. Both players and their companions can freely learn and combine martial arts from various sects. In addition to the techniques from the seven major sects, countless legendary martial arts passed down by ancient masters, mysterious factions, and royal secrets are scattered throughout the world, waiting for the right person to discover them.

As you interact with these great masters, your choices will affect your relationship with them, ultimately determining whether you can learn their unique techniques. Through open-ended story decisions, you can also invite over ten distinct characters, each with their own personality and background, to join your team and build your own Jianghu entourage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/cc19b52e343205b1087cd612f00d59f06eefe844.png[/img]

The protagonist and companions can freely learn martial arts without sect restrictions.

[h3]Life Skills and the Unique Cultivation System[/h3]
A Jianghu journey is not just about sword fights and duels. The game features a rich life skills system—such as medicine, lockpicking, business, persuasion, cooking, fishing, and more—that offers players a diverse gaming experience. Particularly unique is the Cultivation System, where players can capture and nurture various insects, even sending them into battle.

These skills come in handy as you navigate Jianghu: lockpicking allows you to enter buildings at night or open precious treasure chests hidden in mazes; persuasion triggers unique dialogue options, earning NPC trust and granting higher task rewards or leading to different story outcomes; business skills increase your trading profits and help you spot commercial traps. At the same time, life skills can unlock unique story paths, allowing you to solve challenges in unexpected ways.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/ef5692db807ce5e57f3bf3186d82b361aed530d9.png[/img]

notes.title: Open-World Indie Game Beast Saga EA Version Launches on March 6th
notes.content:
Developed by the indie studio Jiaxing Obsidian, Beast Saga is an open-world martial arts RPG that will enter Early Access on Steam on March 6th. The game is priced at $17.99 with a 10% launch discount. In Beast Saga, you will step into the shoes of Lang Jiusi, a young wolf warrior from the Wolf Clan, and embark on an adventure through a vast, dynamic world. Experience the freedom to explore, gather resources, craft items, and master martial arts techniques. Build relationships with fellow adventurers, encounter unexpected adventures, and create your own legend in a world rich with lore. Every decision you make in the non-linear storyline will shape your unique journey and contribute to your very own martial arts saga.

[h3]Launch Trailer:[/h3]https://youtu.be/fFRMEn_k20A
In Beast Saga, players will start their journey in the prologue, where they can begin forming bonds with companions. Through pivotal story choices, you can invite them to join your party. What's more, you can recruit up to 10 female characters, spanning both heroic and villainous personalities.
The game’s storyline is shaped by the choices you make, allowing you to influence the direction of the narrative. Uncover hidden clues and make key decisions to affect the plot and change character endings. The village where your character was born, destroyed in the prologue, can be slowly rebuilt over time. As you progress, you’ll encounter NPCs who are homeless or retired martial artists wishing to leave their pasts behind. You can invite them to settle in your village, helping it rise from the ashes and gradually restoring it to its former vitality.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/db29231914eebf295dc8d38a599ca899b99815e2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Seamless Open World Exploration – A Martial Arts World of Seven Factions and Eventful Storylines[/h3]
In Beast Saga, the seamless world map brings to life a vast, dynamic world filled with seven major factions, various other forces, and hidden sects. You are free to explore this new world and embark on adventures. The Seven Factions—such as the Breaking Dao Heavenly Palace, Wuzi Temple, and Huangyu Valley—offer opportunities to become a disciple and master their unique martial arts. Each faction has its own specialized, multi-layered questline, enhancing the variety and depth of faction gameplay. You can also unlock hidden storylines to become a manor lord, engage in trade and commerce to earn wealth, or join secret factions that focus on theft, assassination, and other dark objectives. Through free exploration, you’ll encounter numerous events, revealing hidden secrets in this original martial arts world, and gradually uncover the ultimate truth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/016c3f4d8e861d74ff166c4daaa165e9fc91d02d.png[/img]
Seamless World Map

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/a7b5ce0d0bde087c1f7ae44b444a1166f6b5eca1.png[/img]
The game features a variety of diverse landscapes, including vast plains, dense forests, rugged mountains, serene lakes and swamps, as well as towering snowy peaks. 

[h3]Real-Time 24-Hour Cycle & Dynamic Weather[/h3]
Beast Saga features a true 24-hour day-night cycle, where the changing times of day significantly affect gameplay. For example, during the night, locations like inns and banks close, and you'll no longer be able to find shopkeepers to buy goods. However, you can use life skills like lockpicking to sneak into places if needed. Certain creatures, like specific types of insects, only appear during certain times of day. Most NPCs are active during the day, while those involved with the underworld might only be found at night. Additionally, some story events and quests can only be triggered during specific times, allowing players to experience different gameplay and narrative outcomes depending on the time of day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/5b46ec4ab0b28191f2824090b37a0085da78666f.png[/img]
Twilight time of the Hundred Spirits Faction
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/643b11cfb8b3da00e01ecf5ab437c50a8f001b5e.png[/img]
Unlocking Buildings at Night with Lockpicking Skill

[h3]Non-linear, Unlimited Open-Ended Story – Diverse NPCs and Choices[/h3]
While Beast Saga offers a main storyline and side quests tied to the Seven Great Factions, you are free to explore the world at your own pace. With no time constraints, you can engage in events that interest you. Your decisions will directly affect how NPCs respond to you, with most quests offering multiple solutions. Most of the story quests allow you to influence the direction of the narrative by changing your choices, discovering hidden clues, and altering the course of events. These decisions not only shape the story and character outcomes but may also pull you into the tangled web of Jianghu conspiracies, trigger hidden quests, unlock secret treasures, or lead to unexpected adventures. Your choices may even impact the progression of other quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/ed8c260618263b6f208d6e74d185e61caac63ecf.png[/img]
 Unlimited Open-Ended Storyline: Your Choices Define Your Path

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/44a61b954a717cff62f5fcb27ecaeb10c752735c.png[/img]
Turn-Based Combat System

[h3]Form Alliances with Jianghu Heroes - Over 300 Martial Arts Skills to Mix and Master[/h3]
In Beast Saga, you can recruit characters from the Seven Great Factions to join your team. Each of these characters has their own unique backstory and can become invaluable allies in uncovering the truth of the world. The game offers over 300 different martial arts techniques, including not only those taught by the Seven Factions but also hidden legendary skills passed down by martial arts masters, mysterious factions, and royal secrets scattered across the world. You can freely combine these martial arts to enhance both your character and your companions, tailoring your skills to suit your playstyle. As you form bonds with your companions, your choices will affect how they respond to you, shaping the development of your relationships with them. Additionally, through open-ended story decisions, you’ll have the opportunity to invite dozens of other diverse characters into your team, each with their own unique traits and abilities.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/2aadd8b87e6d270ea1e5719d4eb4adb1e1f5184e.png[/img]
Martial Arts & Internal Cultivation System

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/8dba982c3ec7f96e1fd55edcc4c0948ffe7eb67d.png[/img]
Companion Martial Arts Customization

[h3]Gathering, Cultivation, Fishing, Medicine, and Commerce – Unlock Diverse Life Skills[/h3]
In Beast Saga, you can gather various resources and fish for ingredients that are essential for crafting weapons, gear, potions, and delicious meals. Characters can learn a variety of life skills, including medicine, lockpicking, commerce, persuasion, cooking, and fishing. The Lockpicking skill allows you to sneak into buildings during the night when they are closed, while Persuasion can open up new dialogue options throughout your journey, helping you earn NPCs’ trust. Commerce impacts your profits from trading and lets you easily spot traps in business dealings. These life skills not only enhance your character’s abilities but also offer unique ways to interact with the world and uncover hidden opportunities.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/723b91717bc93005058a4bdb61583dcd72443b25.png[/img]
Learn Recipes to Craft Equipment

notes.title: 《灵兽江湖》即将参展广州核聚变，现已开启商店页面！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/0cfc22f236b25a0258c5a057ee057bf68bca631d.jpg[/img]

《灵兽江湖》是一款crpg模式的角色扮演游戏，采用多线网状叙事的玩法设计，在广大的武侠开放世界中，讲述了一个名叫狼九思的狼族少年，在宿命的安排下，成为朝廷御史，懵懂闯入江湖，成为多方势力相互倾轧的中心，在漩涡中不断成长，逐渐掌握自己命运的故事。

[h2]官方Q群[/h2]
灵兽江湖一群 禾兴城：769650171

[h3]不受束缚地肆意冒险[/h3]
玩家可以在真正的无缝开放世界中不受束缚地肆意冒险，触发有趣的任务和事件，探索未知的谜题和迷宫，搜集、制造神兵利器，加入各大武林门派，随意搭配多达300多种武学技能。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/02bf2d047e0e5d042758dbbeffa2a095c3ed16e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/c40848f4335c6d960ae204c4042bc04bef860af9.png[/img]

[h3]培养自己的侠客团队[/h3]
与十余位性格迥异的侠士伙伴一起闯荡天涯，所有入队角色如何加点，如何进行武功搭配，都完全由玩家决定，玩家可以自由地培养独属于自己的侠客团队。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/4c895a1e55196bfc0e7f31528248a60bd7c7ad17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/c7890d5769a504f8dbb97a300ff88bbd569c50b2.png[/img]

[h3]是正是邪都由你决定[/h3]
游戏任务设计灵活，充分体现了玩家对整个武林世界的人和事的影响。种种分支和可能性摆在玩家面前，任何选择都可能影响一个人、一群人，甚至整个江湖的命运。
每位动物伙伴都会自己的故事线，主角可以通过交互实现颠覆式的干预，去拆撒固定CP，打造十二生肖后宫团。或是屠戮成魔后，主角打破第四面墙，不再听从玩家的某些指令，和玩家直接对线。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194544/05edc050ea0db9550c67fa124a7f02e6b8f0718b.png[/img]
